lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); FOLLOW = nil; LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = nova.terrain_height(v.x, v.z); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, v.x, g + (ty or 0.9), v.z, fov or 40 } end; IN_VAN = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(x, z, h); local sc = nova.scene_now(); sc.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.reset(h) end; PARK = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v.driven = false; v.engine_on = false; v:teleport(x, z, h); nova.scene_now().mode = 'foot'; nova.named('postmaster').seated = false end; AT = function(ex, ey, ez, tx, ty, tz, fov) CAM.pinned = { ex, nova.terrain_height(ex, ez) + ey, ez, tx, nova.terrain_height(tx, tz) + ty, tz, fov or 50 } end; FROM = function(name, ahead, side, up, look_up, fov) local d = nova.named(name); local ry = d.ry or 0; local fx, fz = math.sin(ry), math.cos(ry); AT(d.x + fx * ahead + fz * side, up, d.z + fz * ahead - fx * side, d.x, look_up, d.z, fov) end
